paragraph: On 30 October 2026 the finance ministry [issued the 2027 budget proposal's allocation by organ of state from SIGFE](<https://cms.minfin.gov.ao/api/assets/portal-minfin/0ada73f8-0c75-43bd-87e0-2f046d0baf43/>), the state's integrated financial management system. [A September 2026 paper by CIAT authors says the tax authority's SIGT handles taxpayer registration, declarations, assessment and payment](<https://www.ciat.org/modernisation-of-general-tax-administration-over-the-last-10-years-a-tax-and-customs-analysis/?lang=en>). In the last twelve months, [on 29 October 2026 the public-administration ministry launched SINGERH as the civil service's new integrated human-resources system](<https://africa-newsroom.com/press/sistema-integrado-de-gestao-de-recursos-humanos-da-funcao-publica-singerh-registra-mais-de-31-mil-trabalhadores-com-dados-cadastrais-por-regularizar-em-angola?lang=pt>). No source found says the government has published an enterprise architecture or an inventory of its systems. Mature would need such an architecture or inventory to be published.

No stage is set. No source found from 2023 or later says the government's financial management system is in use. In the last twelve months, a source found named [SIGFP_BI](<https://pafen.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/AAO_SIGFP.pdf>) without saying that it is in use. Two further sources name the same system, and neither says it runs. Preparing would need a source from 2023 or later that says the government budgets, accounts and pays through a computer system.

No stage is set. The tax directorate [rolled out its SIGIBé platform for large and medium taxpayers in 2022](<https://ictd.ac/general/benins-e-tax-rollout-small-businesses-digital-public-infrastructure/>). It [extended the platform to small businesses in 2024](<https://ictd.ac/general/benins-e-tax-rollout-small-businesses-digital-public-infrastructure/>). [Electronic payments exceed 96% for most taxes](<https://ictd.ac/general/benins-e-tax-rollout-small-businesses-digital-public-infrastructure/>), according to the directorate's 2025 activity report. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found says whether the budget, accounts and payments or the payroll run on a computer system. Preparing would need a source from 2023 or later that says the government budgets, accounts and pays through a computer system.

[Botswana's Minister of Communications and Innovation told Parliament on 18 March 2025 that the Government Accounting and Budgeting System (GABS) was fixed in December 2024](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/85274>). Technical faults had disrupted payments across all ministries, departments and agencies. The Minister said it has since run at full capacity for over 20,000 users. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found from 2023 or later says the tax authority's system or the civil-service payroll runs on a computer system. Establishing would need tax collection and the civil-service payroll to run on computer systems, shown by sources from 2023 or later.

In June 2025 the IMF noted [the adoption of the integrated financial information system](<https://ecomatin.net/le-fmi-annonce-un-nouveau-decaissement-de-334-milliards-fcfa-au-profit-de-la-centrafrique>) at the treasury directorate and in line ministries. The tax directorate's director general said in January 2025 that the [e-Tax system's registration and e-filing modules were fully operational](<https://itweb.africa/article/central-african-republic-advances-with-tax-digitalisation/rW1xL75n43RMRk6m>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found from 2023 or later says how the civil-service payroll is run. The finance ministry's March 2025 plan lists an [integrated human resources management system](<https://www.finances.gouv.cf/sites/default/files/2025-03/Plan%20e-Finances%20publiques-Note%20de%20cadrage-Pr%C3%A9sentation%2026%20mars%202025%20(1).pdf>) as still to be set up. Establishing would need the civil-service payroll to run on a computer system, shown by a source from 2023 or later.

In July 2026 SNDI's deputy director general described budget execution at Katiola, where [every actor in it, the prefecture included, executes and tracks its budget over a satellite network](<https://ivoirexpress.ci/2026/07/28/digitalisation-des-services-publics-en-cote-divoire-les-applications-metiers-developpees-par-la-sndi/>). SNDI is the state's IT company. Its chief executive said in 2014 that [SIGFIP, the public finance system it built, was used across government](<https://marcopolis.net/overview-of-sndi-it-development-company-in-cote-d-ivoire.htm>). In the last twelve months, the July 2026 account is the only newer description of budget execution on a computer system. No source found from 2023 or later says the tax system or the civil-service payroll is in use. Establishing would need both to run on computer systems, shown by sources from 2023 or later.

No stage is set. No source found from 2023 or later says the government's financial management system is in use. The same holds for the tax system. Sources found name [SIGIPES](<https://www.minfopra.gov.cm/index.php/fr/a-la-une/2021-partenariat-le-minfopra-et-la-camtel-pour-une-convention-de-partenariat-gagnant-gagnant-2>), [ANTILOPE](<https://www.minfopra.gov.cm/index.php/fr/a-la-une/2021-partenariat-le-minfopra-et-la-camtel-pour-une-convention-de-partenariat-gagnant-gagnant-2>), [SYDONIA](<https://thedocs.worldbank.org/en/doc/379941605627277587-0090022020/original/DE4ACameroonCountryDiagnosticJun26.pdf>) and [AIGLES](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202411/cameroon-squares-up-to-its-payroll-fraud-conundrum-with-biometric-verification>), which do not answer that. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a source from 2023 or later that says the government budgets, accounts and pays through a computer system.

In October 2024 the finance ministry said that [SIGOF, the state's public finance system, pays suppliers and staff, and was unstable in October 2024](<https://expressodasilhas.cv/pais/2024/10/11/instabilidade-no-sigof-pode-causar-atrasos-nos-pagamentos-do-estado/93685>). The ministry describes it as centralising state public finance management across the budget cycle. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found from 2023 or later says the tax authority's system or the civil-service payroll is in use. Establishing would need tax collection and the civil-service payroll to run on computer systems, shown by sources from 2023 or later.

The finance minister told parliament that [the Treasury's information system has run spending under the programme budget since 1 January 2023](<https://ouest-tribune.dz/numerisation-du-secteur-des-finances-les-applications-et-plateformes-ont-permis-de-realiser-des-progres-notables/>). The minister said [the Djibayatic tax system covered 40 centres by February 2024](<https://ouest-tribune.dz/numerisation-du-secteur-des-finances-les-applications-et-plateformes-ont-permis-de-realiser-des-progres-notables/>). On 29 November 2024 the ministry [launched the first phase of its integrated budget management system, SIGB](<https://lasentinelle.dz/index.php/2024/12/01/systeme-integre-de-gestion-budgetaire-sigb-lancement-de-la-premiere-phase-de-deploiement/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found from 2023 or later says the civil-service payroll runs on a computer system. Establishing would need the payroll to run on a computer system, shown by a source from 2023 or later.

The Tax Authority's head said in October 2025 that a [unified platform computes employers' wage tax](<https://eta.gov.eg/ar/news/mnzwmt-twhyd-ass-wmayyr-ahtsab-drybt-alajwr-walmrtbat-ysahm-fy-thqyq-aldalt-aldrybyt>), and passes it to the authority's mechanised system for payment. [The Egyptian Cabinet spokesman said the government Payroll system had been activated in 2,281 of 2,675 target accounting units](<https://cabinet.gov.eg/News/Details/75069>). [In June 2024 the finance ministry said it is strengthening the link between its e-payment centre and GFMIS](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/3/12/525882/Business/Economy/Epayment,-collection-services-in-Egypt-rise-to-EGP.aspx>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the financial, tax or payroll system went live on a new or upgraded system since October 2023. Operating would need one of the three core systems to go live on a new or upgraded system in the last three years.

In 2025 the Ministry of Finance's [full-year EFY 2017 (Sene-2017) federal budget vs expenditure report is drawn from IFMIS](<https://www.mofed.gov.et/media/filer_public/c4/ed/c4ede8e5-2fc8-419e-8129-c9ddea96364f/fourth_quarter_2017_report.xlsx>). It states that of 174 federal public sites, 118 use IFMIS and 56 use IBEX, reported separately. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found from 2023 or later says the tax authority's system or the civil-service payroll is in use. Establishing would need tax collection and the civil-service payroll to run on computer systems, shown by sources from 2023 or later.

On 15 January 2026 the government [launched SIGFIP, which handles the state's spending and revenue on one platform](<https://gabon-info.com/2026/01/15/le-gabon-reprend-la-main-sur-sa-souverainete-financiere-et-numerique/>). The minister said the administration built it in house and owns its source code. [SIGFIP brings tax, customs and non-tax revenue into one database with one payment interface](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news/1801-52022-gabon-launches-integrated-digital-platform-for-public-finance-management>), Ecofin Agency reports. The public service ministry keeps state staff records on [the Fichier unique de référence, in use for about twenty years](<https://union.sonapresse.com/fr/fonction-publique-redynamiser-le-fichier-unique-de-reference>), which feeds the Solde payroll. In the last twelve months, [SIGFIP went live on 15 January 2026, moving Gabon from fragmented systems to one integrated platform (Ecofin Agency)](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news/1801-52022-gabon-launches-integrated-digital-platform-for-public-finance-management>). No source found says the government has published an enterprise architecture or an inventory of its systems. Mature would need one to be published.

The finance ministry's 2026-2029 budget guidelines [require regional councils and district assemblies to process all transactions through GIFMIS](<https://www.mofep.gov.gh/sites/default/files/news/2026-2029_Budget_Preparation_Guidelines_v2.pdf>), the integrated financial management system. In the last twelve months, in September 2026 the revenue authority said [some parts of its new tax administration system, ITAS, were already working](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/gras-itas-and-other-digital-platforms-set-to-strengthen-tax-compliance/>). In August 2026 [all taxpayers still filed on GITMIS](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/understanding-ghanas-new-integrated-tax-administration-system-itas/>). The Controller and Accountant-General's Department runs the government payroll, [linked to the national identity database in January 2024](<https://nia.gov.gh/government-launches-integrated-database-for-payroll-validation-and-verification/>). No source found says a core system went live on a new or upgraded system since October 2023. Operating would need one of the three core systems to go live on a new or upgraded system in the last three years.

[In August 2026 the Accountant General's Department said IFMIS is operational in larger ministries and agencies](<https://gambiana.com/agd-disputes-bensoudas-claim-over-ifmis-use-at-kmc/>). [The GRA Commissioner General said the current domestic tax administration system is largely manual](<https://www.voicegambia.com/2026/06/17/gra-says-new-itas-will-transform-tax-administration-in-the-gambia/>). The new ITAS is to replace it. In the last twelve months IFMIS was cited and not changed. No source found from 2023 or later says the civil-service payroll runs on a computer system. Establishing would need tax collection and the civil-service payroll to run on computer systems, shown by sources from 2023 or later.

No stage is set. The IMF says Guinea-Bissau [launched a blockchain platform for the public payroll in May 2024](<https://www.mef.gw/noticias/fmi-sauda-a-implementacao-da-plataforma-para-melhorar-gestao-da-folha-salarial>), under its Extended Credit Facility programme. The IMF said it could cover all 26,600 civil servants and 8,100 pensioners by November 2024. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found from 2023 or later says how the budget is executed and paid, or describes the tax system. Preparing would need a source from 2023 or later that says the government budgets, accounts and pays through a computer system.

[On 10 February 2025 the Interministerial Council took up new directives for the CONFIN system](<https://www.guineaecuatorialpress.com/noticias/primera_reunion_del_consejo_interministerial_de_2025>), which cover the whole public administration and autonomous bodies. CONFIN is described as an integrated public finance management system built for executing current expenditure of the state budget. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found from 2023 or later says the tax authority's system or the civil-service payroll is in use. Establishing would need tax collection and the civil-service payroll to run on computer systems, shown by sources from 2023 or later.

[In October 2026 the revenue authority and the Treasury said all suppliers to government go through the IFMIS payment workflow](<https://peopledaily.digital/business/kra-issues-fresh-directive-to-govt-suppliers-over-invoice-validation-and-payments>). [A Star column says Kenyans filed annual and VAT returns on the KRA iTax portal in June and August 2026](<https://www.the-star.co.ke/opinion/star-blogs/2026-09-01-monari-when-itax-fails-the-taxpayer-still-pays>). [The Unified Human Resource system holds public-service HR and payroll data](<https://techweez.com/2024/06/14/kenya-uhr-egp-under-imf-agreement/>). In the last twelve months, [the ICT ministry published guidelines on the Government Enterprise Architecture in 2026](<https://digitalization.ict.go.ke/download.php?id=2>). No source found says a core system went live on a new or upgraded system since October 2023. The revenue authority said in 2025 it was [upgrading iTax's back end](<https://www.businessdailyafrica.com/bd/economy/kra-in-major-customs-income-tax-systems-upgrade-after-snags-5167392>). Operating would need one of the three core systems to go live on a new or upgraded system in the last three years.

[In May 2026 the finance ministry said it is integrating IFMIS with the LITAS and SIGTAS tax systems](<https://mfdp.gov.lr/index.php/media-center/press-release/joint-press-conference-by-the-ministry-of-finance-and-development-planning-liberia-revenue-authority-and-central-bank-of-liberia-on-gac-s-compliance-audit-report-on-the-government-of-liberia-revenue-collection-and-reconciliation-processes-for-the-period-july-1-2018-to-december-31-2024>). It treats IFMIS as an existing system. The revenue authority's IT project coordinator said in August 2025 that [filing, assessments, payments and collections run on LITAS](<https://revenue.lra.gov.lr/lra-trains-staff-on-new-digital-tax-payment-system/>). In the last twelve months, the May 2026 statement describes the integration as under way, and no source found says it was completed. No source found from 2023 or later says the civil-service payroll runs on a computer system. Establishing would need the payroll to run on a computer system, shown by a source from 2023 or later.

No stage is set. The finance minister said [August 2025 public-sector salaries were processed on the new unified treasury account system](<https://libyaobserver.ly/news/gnu-starts-paying-public-sector-wages-through-new-treasury-system>), after basic data for about 41% of state employees had been uploaded. In the last twelve months, in December 2025 the Libyan Tax Authority [announced the official start of work on the Unified Tax System](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=346934&lang=ar>). Nothing found says the treasury account system or the tax system replaced an older one. Nothing found from 2023 or later describes a financial management system in use across government. Preparing would need a source from 2023 or later that says the government budgets, accounts and pays through a computer system.

[The finance ministry's 2026 terms of reference say all ministries and councils use the Epicor-based IFMIS](<https://www.finance.gov.ls/PDFDocuments/TOR%20IFMIS%20UPGRADE%20PROJECT%20MANAGER-639130560784133389.pdf>). [In December 2023 the World Bank said a human resource management information system was in place](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099012624174578070/pdf/BOSIB1128fca200361b2de12ad6f80d422e.pdf>), with its payroll module in use. [Revenue Services Lesotho's guide of February 2025 describes its e-Taxation platform](<https://www.rsl.org.ls/sites/default/files/2025-02/Guide%20on%20E-Taxation%20Platform%20%28E-Filing%29.pdf>). In the last twelve months the IFMIS was cited and not changed, in the finance ministry's 2026 terms of reference. No source found says a core system went live on a new or upgraded system since October 2023. Operating would need one of the three core systems to go live on a new or upgraded system in the last three years.

No stage is set. No source found from 2023 or later says the government's financial management system or the payroll is in use. An interview with the finance minister names an [Integrated Public Finance Management System (being upgraded)](<https://kaori-media.com/posts/interview-with-hon-rindra-rabarinirinarison-minister-of-economy-and-finance-of-madagascar>), the [AUGURE payroll (being modernised)](<https://kaori-media.com/posts/interview-with-hon-rindra-rabarinirinarison-minister-of-economy-and-finance-of-madagascar>) and [SIGPensions](<https://kaori-media.com/posts/interview-with-hon-rindra-rabarinirinarison-minister-of-economy-and-finance-of-madagascar>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a source from 2023 or later that says the government budgets, accounts and pays through a computer system.

No stage is set. No source found from 2023 or later says the government's financial management system is in use. In the last twelve months, sources found named a [Tier III data centre, Bamako](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/0202-135390-le-mali-inaugure-un-data-center-tier-iii-et-renforce-sa-souverainete-numerique>) and a [Government Intranet](<https://lessor.ml/posts/cyber-espace-le-mali-renforce-sa-viabilite-avec-le-point-ml-69538f175e535>), and neither answers that. Preparing would need a source from 2023 or later that says the government budgets, accounts and pays through a computer system.

The state runs its finances on e-SISTAFE, in place since 2004. In November 2024 the finance ministry said [e-SISTAFE has 11 modules, all working except internal audit](<https://www.mef.gov.mz/index.php/imprensa/noticias/847-amilcar-tivane-nas-celebracoes-dos-20-anos-do-e-sistafe>). In November 2025 the finance minister described [SESPE, an e-SISTAFE service that collects taxes and fees electronically](<https://www.mef.gov.mz/index.php/imprensa/discursos/2455-cge-2024-discurso-inicial-sexcia-mf-20-11-2025/file>). In October 2025 the ministry said e-SNGRHE, the civil-service system, [removes employees from the payroll automatically](<https://360mozambique.com/development/biometric-verification-removes-over-18000-nonexistent-employees-from-the-state-payroll/>) when they miss the yearly biometric proof of life. In the last twelve months, [in September 2026 CEDSIF listed e-Tributação as the domestic tax system](<https://www.cedsif.gov.mz/cedsifportal/?page_id=81>), cited and not changed. No source found says a core system went live on a new or upgraded system since October 2023. Operating would need one to do so in the last three years.

[The Central Informatics Bureau lists the Treasury Accounting System as operational](<https://cib.govmu.org/Documents/Reports/List%20of%20Operational%20Systems.pdf>). The same November 2024 list names the finance ministry's E-Budget. [Individuals filed their 2025 tax returns on the revenue authority's e-filing system](<https://www.mra.mu/eservices1/individual/individual-e-filing-season>). [The division built the new payroll system in house and it went live in July 2024](<https://cisd.govmu.org/Documents/Newsletter/Enewsletter%20issue%20No.6.pdf>), after a parallel run in June. No change has been found in the last twelve months. [The bureau's 2025 progress update marks as done the publication of a catalogue of information systems](<https://cib.govmu.org/Documents/Reports/Progress_Update_DGTS_Mauritius.pdf>).

The Accountant General said in May 2024 that the SAP-based IFMIS, [rolled out to all ministries, departments and agencies a year earlier, was fully operational](<https://mwnation.com/ifmis-has-fully-stabilisedsays-accountant-general/>). The Accountant General told a parliamentary committee in February 2024 that [the government payroll runs on the human resource management information system](<https://times.mw/k3-5-billion-needed-for-ifmis-upgrade/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found from 2023 or later says the tax authority's system is in use. Establishing would need tax collection to run on a computer system as well, shown by a source from 2023 or later.

No stage is set. No source found from 2023 or later says the government's financial management system is in use. In the last twelve months, sources found named the [Integrated Social Assistance System (ISAS)](<https://hppii.gov.na/activities/activity-2-consolidation-of-social-grants-and-the-food-bank/>), the [Integrated Beneficiary Registry (IBR)](<https://hppii.gov.na/activities/activity-2-consolidation-of-social-grants-and-the-food-bank/>) and the [GIPF database](<https://hppii.gov.na/activities/activity-2-consolidation-of-social-grants-and-the-food-bank/>), and none answers that. Preparing would need a source from 2023 or later that says the government budgets, accounts and pays through a computer system.

In April 2025 [FIRS ordered all tax collections run through TaxPro Max](<https://theeconomictimes.com.ng/2025/04/30/firs-orders-banks-to-shut-down-unauthorised-tax-collection-accounts-mandates-use-of-taxpro-max/>), the platform for registration, filing and payment. In July 2026 the Accountant-General said [IPPIS covers 508 ministries, departments and agencies and over 1,008,800 employee records](<https://thewillnews.com/fg-launches-digital-hr-system-ends-manual-staff-postings-across-civil-service/>). In the last twelve months, [the IPPIS HR modules went live on 27 July 2026](<https://fmino.gov.ng/fg-launches-ippis-human-resource-modules-deepens-digital-transformation-of-civil-service/>) on SoftSuite, a locally developed platform, replacing the Oracle E-Business Suite. On 28 August 2026 the President [ordered an audit of how IPPIS links with GIFMIS, the Treasury Single Account and Sub-TSA](<https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/08/29/fake-agencies-tinubu-orders-forensic-sweep-of-ippis-ministries-fg-institutions/>). In March 2026 [NITDA took over the Nigeria Government Enterprise Architecture from KOICA](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/03/27/nitda-takes-over-nigeria-government-enterprise-architecture-in-major-digital-governance-milestone/>).

[The revenue authority's 2025 Tax Handbook says taxpayers declare online or by phone on E-Tax and M-Declaration](<https://www.rra.gov.rw/fileadmin/Folder_for_2025/RRA_Tax_Handbook_2025_Final.pdf>). [The public service ministry says IPPIS supports public institutions from recruitment to exit](<https://www.mifotra.gov.rw/1/mifotra-spiu>), including payroll management for salary payments. [MINECOFIN says it completed a major technological upgrade of the IFMIS](<https://www.minecofin.gov.rw/news-detail/ifmis-upgraded-to-modern-platform-strengthening-public-financial-management>), replacing legacy components that had reached end of support. No date for the upgrade has been found, so no change within the last twelve months is shown. [RISA's Government of Rwanda Enterprise Architecture Framework, Version 2.1, states the government chose TOGAF](<https://risa.prod.risa.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/RISA/Publications/1.Guidelines/GOR_s_Enterprise_Architecture_Framework.pdf>).

No stage is set. No source found from 2023 or later says the government's financial management system is in use. In the last twelve months the Bayan civil-service records platform was launched, in August 2026, and no source found shows it in service. Sources found name [Esali (electronic collection and payment system)](<https://allafrica.com/stories/202604160259.html>), a [Treasury Single Account (TSA)](<https://allafrica.com/stories/202604160259.html>) and an [Integrated Financial Management Information System (IFMIS)](<https://allafrica.com/stories/202604160259.html>). Preparing would need a source from 2023 or later that says the government budgets, accounts and pays through a computer system.

[The Treasury's 2024 report says its revenue and expenditure operations between ASTER and SIGCDD were automated that year](<https://www.vie-publique.sn/docs/72afedd6-17cc-46f8-bd98-fb673c0b3291/rapport-d-activites-2024-de-la-direction-generale-de-la-comptabilite-publique-et-du-tresor-dgcpt.pdf>). [Terms of reference of November 2023 list the eSolde payroll among the state's systems in use](<https://paens.sn/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/PAENS_TDR_INN_ARCHITECTURE-GOUV_-4-SENUM-BM_valide.pdf>). In the last twelve months, the directorate's [communiqué of 27 August 2026](<https://www.dgid.sn/storage/uploads/communique-sentax-1790185473.pdf>) says SENTAX now replaces the ETAX application for online declaration and payment by large taxpayers. Since 1 September 2026 the platform [has been mandatory for every declaration and payment by large-enterprise taxpayers](<https://www.dgid.sn/sentax>). No source found says the government has published an enterprise architecture or an inventory of its systems. Mature would need one to be published.

[World Bank terms of reference of 2025 say the finance ministry has launched IFMIS among its core public finance systems](<https://wbgeprocure-rfxnow.worldbank.org/rfxnow/waffle/upload/advertisementAttachment/603116/file.html>). [They say these systems run standalone](<https://wbgeprocure-rfxnow.worldbank.org/rfxnow/waffle/upload/advertisementAttachment/603116/file.html>). In October 2025 the Principal Deputy Financial Secretary said [the government had invested over USD 300 million in standalone systems including IFMIS](<https://a-zsl.com/dfmst-and-stakeholders-conclude-two-day-validation-exercise-on-draft-interoperability-roadmap/>). [The Revenue Authority's Commissioner General said taxpayers can now file and pay electronically through ITAS](<https://sierraloaded.sl/news/nra-digital-tax-mobile-payments-modernise/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found from 2023 or later says the civil-service payroll runs on a computer system. Establishing would need the payroll to run on a computer system, shown by a source from 2023 or later.

[The FY2025 annual report states digital signatures were introduced in SFMIS to re-engineer payment processes](<https://mof.gov.so/sites/default/files/Publications/FGS_Annual_Report%20_%26_Consolidated_Financial_Statements.pdf>). [The Electronic Tax Administration System (ETAS) and other digital platforms improved automation and streamlined revenue collection in 2025](<https://mof.gov.so/sites/default/files/Publications/FGS_Annual_Report%20_%26_Consolidated_Financial_Statements.pdf>). [The Office of the Accountant General's letter of 29 August 2026 refers to the existing government payroll system](<https://en.goobjoog.com/somalia-to-link-government-payroll-system-with-national-id-database/>).
